Strategy: Refine the distribution-plus-worst-fit family with a spread gate and an exact-fit bonus: an exact fit always wins, otherwise use worst fit when the spread is at least the item size, and Best Fit when bins are nearly equal. The choice differs from Best Fit when the spread is wide and no exact fit exists, since the loosest bin wins. Wide-spread worst fit may preserve tight bins, but it can strand space in loose bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    spread = max(bins) - min(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if spread >= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
